name: apnagalla
description: ApnaGalla: offline-first invoicing app (Capacitor + React) with a Node/Postgres sync backend

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w app
scripts.build:railway: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w @invoice/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w app
